# Lancaster Pediatric Dentistry

> A pediatric dental practice in Lancaster, Ohio specializing in comprehensive dental care for children, from preventive services to specialized treatment for special needs patients.

Lancaster Pediatric Dentistry is led by Dr. Jonathan W. Draney and a team of experienced pediatric dentists including Dr. Cole Bryant, Dr. Cynetha Henderson, and Dr. Mitchell Thai. The practice provides evidence-based care aligned with American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry standards and emphasizes patient education, preventive care, and family-centered treatment.

## Services

- [All Services](https://www.lancasterpediatricdentistry.com/all-services): Complete list of pediatric dental services offered
- [Preventive Services](https://www.lancasterpediatricdentistry.com/preventive-services): Preventive dental services including cleanings and sealants
- [Treatment & Surgery Services](https://www.lancasterpediatricdentistry.com/treatment-surgery): Treatment and surgical services including fillings and root canals
- [Emergency Services](https://www.lancasterpediatricdentistry.com/emergency-services): Emergency dental care services and after-hours support
- [Special Needs Dentistry](https://www.lancasterpediatricdentistry.com/special-needs-dentistry): Specialized dental care for children with special needs
